horologion.prayer_all_holy_trinity.desc: Prayer: O all-holy Trinity, Consubstantial Might, Undivided Kingship, Source and Origin of all goodness, deal kindly with me, a sinner; strengthen my innermost spirit, cleanse me of all evil, and enlighten my mind that I may ever glorify You with this prayer: One is Holy, One is Lord, Jesus Christ, to the glory of God the Father. Amen.
